First, let's sketch the graph of $y=\operatorname{arctan}⁡(2x+7):$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14189988/assets/371cbb841c67494626038fc93747a1d0a2b2245f422364911f1a859f4711868d.png)

The domain of $\operatorname{arctan}⁡(2x+7)$ is $(-\infty ,\infty ).$ Moreover, from the graph, we see that

$$
{lim}_{x\to -\infty }\operatorname{arctan}⁡(2x+7)=-\frac{\pi }{2}.
$$

Therefore,

$$
{lim}_{x\to \,-\infty }\frac{5}{2\pi }(\operatorname{arctan}⁡(2x+7))=\frac{5}{2\pi }\cdot (-\frac{\pi }{2})=-\frac{5}{4}.
$$
